    rows=np.asarray(rows,float)

def ink_pose(c,t,w,offset=(0,0)):
    from plan_character import depth_from_width
    dep=float(depth_from_width(2*w*.22186))

def stroke_rows(knots,offset=(0,0),speed=.012):
    from plan_character import sample
    xy,t,w=sample(knots,step=1.5)
    arr=[]
    # Gathered moving entry and a retracting lift, all along stroke length.
    for ww in np.linspace(.05,w[0],12): arr.append(ink_pose(xy[0],t[0],ww,offset))
    arr.extend([ink_pose(c,v,ww,offset) for c,v,ww in zip(xy,t,w)])
    for ww in np.linspace(w[-1],.05,12)[1:]: arr.append(ink_pose(xy[-1],t[-1],ww,offset))
    arr=np.array(arr)
    dist=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(arr[:,:3],axis=0),axis=1)
    tt=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.maximum(dist,.00002))/speed]
    times=np.arange(0,tt[-1]+.05,.05)
    p=np.column_stack([np.interp(times,tt,arr[:,i]) for i in range(7)])
    # Lead the robot's measured 80 ms tracking lag.
    vel=np.gradient(p[:,:3],.05,axis=0)
    p[:,:3]+=.08*vel

def fuller_dot_rows(knots,offset=(0,0)):
    # Sustain pressure through the finishing turn, then lift at the final tip.
    arr=stroke_rows(knots,offset)
    dep=SURFACE-arr[:,2]
    peak=int(np.argmax(dep))
    # Detect the beginning of the final vertical lift, when XY becomes stationary.
    xy_speed=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(arr[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1)
    lastmoving=np.where(xy_speed>0.000025)[0][-1]+1
    end=arr[lastmoving].copy()
    arr=arr[:lastmoving+1].copy()
    arr[peak:,2]=np.minimum(arr[peak:,2],SURFACE-float(dep.max())*.90)
    end[:2]=arr[-1,:2]; end[2]=SURFACE+.001
    lift=linear([arr[-1],end],speed=.02)
    return np.r_[arr,np.array(lift)]

def write_fuller_dot(knots,offset=(0,0),label='fuller dot'):
    dip();arr=fuller_dot_rows(knots,offset)
